title: receive_rrep ignores signature field - auth bypass
description: Line 300-314: receive_rrep() validates address/seq fields but ignores signature. Attacker sends RREP with matching fields but no/invalid signature, receive_rrep returns Ok, caller installs attacker-controlled route. Fix: enforce signature presence or add verified flag from link layer.
close_reason: Fixed: Added MissingSignature error and signature presence check in receive_rrep() to prevent unauthenticated route injection attacks. Added test for rejection of unsigned RREPs.
